newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end higher, but off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end higher, but off early highs.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Tuesday as investors took fresh positions on new accounts day, but profit-taking near the close wiped out some of the early gains, dealers said.
"Continuous buying by foreign investors has improved morale of local investors," a dealer at Ali Hussain Rajabali said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 16.20 points, or 1.17 percent, to end at 1,397.22. The index had soared to 1,406.60 in early trade.
Gainers led losers 151 to 38. Turnover rose to 29.45 million shares from 24.99 million in the previous session.
Bank of Punjab rose 1.0 rupee to 18.25 and Muslim Commercial Bank 1.55 to 32.25. Adamjee Insurance rose 1.25 to 89.50. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 1.10 to 32.65.
Hub Power Co rose 0.20 to 34.45 and Pakistan State Oil 2.0 to 275. PTCL rose 0.70 to 25.70 and Telecard Ltd 4.0 to 52. Fauji Fertilizer rose 1.0 to 70.
